title: Shyam's Portfolio
_note: Edit quantities here. 'symbol' is the Yahoo Finance symbol (ASX tickers use the .AX suffix). Company details (full_name, sector, industry, hq, description, logo) show on each tile; 'logo' is a file in logos/ (leave empty for a monogram). 'logo_scale' (0.5-1) shrinks bold square marks so all logos look balanced.

holdings.name: Nu Holdings
holdings.description: Operates Nubank, one of the world's largest digital banks, serving more than 100 million customers in Brazil, Mexico and Colombia with credit cards, accounts, loans and investments.

holdings.name: Bougainville Copper
holdings.description: Holds the Panguna copper-gold mine on Bougainville, once one of the world's largest open-pit copper mines. Operations have been suspended since 1989; its main shareholders, the Autonomous Bougainville Government and PNG Government, are exploring a restart.

holdings.name: EML Payments
holdings.description: Issues and processes prepaid, gift and reloadable cards and digital payment accounts for businesses and governments across Australia, the UK, Europe and North America.

holdings.name: Gentrack Group
holdings.description: Provides cloud-based billing and customer software (g2.0) for energy and water utilities worldwide, and airport operations software through its Veovo business.

holdings.name: On Holding
holdings.description: Swiss sportswear brand known for its CloudTec-cushioned running shoes, selling performance and lifestyle footwear and apparel worldwide.

holdings.name: IREN Ltd
holdings.description: Builds and operates large-scale data centres powered by renewable energy, using them for bitcoin mining and, increasingly, GPU-based AI cloud computing. Formerly Iris Energy.

holdings.name: Cameco
holdings.description: One of the world's largest uranium producers, with mines in Saskatchewan and Kazakhstan, nuclear fuel services, and a 49% stake in reactor maker Westinghouse Electric.

holdings.name: Alphabet (Class C)
holdings.description: Parent company of Google: Search, YouTube, Android, Chrome and Google Cloud, plus AI research at Google DeepMind and ventures such as Waymo.

holdings.name: Tesla
holdings.description: Designs and manufactures electric vehicles, battery energy storage and solar products, and is developing self-driving and humanoid-robot technology.

_note_cash: Cash balances: add one entry per currency. 'amount' is in 'currency' (AUD, USD or SGD supported out of the box; any other ISO code is fetched as <CCY>USD=X by update_prices.py). Cash counts in totals and weights but has no price or day change.

cash.label: Cash (AUD)
cash.description: Cash held in Australian dollars. Valued at face value and converted to US and Singapore dollars at the latest AUD/USD and USD/SGD rates; it has no daily price change.
